description.id: Rope Access Center (RAC) adalah brand pelatihan dan jasa akses tali dari grup Inland: pelatihan K3 kerja di ketinggian bersertifikat Kemnaker RI (TKPK dan TKBT) serta jasa rope access untuk gedung dan industri.
description.en: Rope Access Center (RAC) is the rope access training and services brand of the Inland group: Kemnaker-certified work-at-height training (TKPK and TKBT) and rope access services for buildings and industry.
